_readme: Manually logged punishments. Sleeper knows who EARNED a punishment, but it
has no idea whether anyone actually served it -- so that part lives here.
Edit this file (on github.com directly is fine), commit, and the next build
Match a team with either 'manager' (Sleeper username, most reliable) or
'team' (team name). Manager wins if both are present.
count:  how many offenses this entry settles. Defaults to 1. Use it when
one punishment clears several zeros at once.
proof:  optional link -- photo, video, whatever the group chat demanded.
rule: Every zero, negative, or empty slot is one punishment. Serve it or it carries.
